title: Billing and payments for EV charging | VOOL
description: VOOL charges the drivers, issues invoices and pays the site owner every month. No fixed fee and no fee per connector.

sections.title: Drivers pay. You get paid. VOOL does the paperwork.
sections.lead: For apartment associations, offices and public sites that want charging paid by the people who charge. No fixed fee and no fee per connector.

items.title: You set the price
items.text: Per kWh, with different prices for different groups if you want.

items.title: The driver charges and pays
items.text: By card in the VOOL App, or by scanning a QR code at a public charger.

items.title: VOOL invoices the driver
items.text: Every session gets an invoice. You do not issue anything.

items.title: You are paid monthly
items.text: VOOL transfers what the drivers paid, less its fee, with a statement.

sections.title: What it costs
sections.lead: You pay only when VOOL collects money for you.

sections.note: No fixed monthly fee and no fee per connector.

items.title: Apartment associations
items.text: Each resident pays for their own charging. Owners without an electric car pay nothing, and the board issues no invoices.

items.title: Offices and fleets
items.text: Employees pay for private charging, company cars are reported separately.

items.title: Public sites
items.text: Visitors pay without an app or a contract, as AFIR requires.

items.q: Do I need a payment terminal?
items.a: No. Drivers pay in the VOOL App or through a QR code payment page.

items.q: Can residents and guests have different prices?
items.a: Yes. Pricing rules are set per access group.

items.q: What do I need to enter?
items.a: Your electricity cost and the price you want to charge. The Portal shows what you receive per kWh after fees.

items.q: Who handles VAT and invoices to drivers?
items.a: VOOL issues the invoices to drivers. Ask us how VAT applies to your organisation.

items.q: Can I manage billing myself instead?
items.a: Yes. The Portal’s reports show consumption per user, and you can invoice from those yourself at no cost.

sections.title: Want to see what your site would earn?
sections.lead: Send us the number of chargers and your electricity price.
